title: OpenAvatar 0.1 document
description: An animated character for AI agents, data only. Spec: https://openavatar.dev/spec/0.1. Limits that JSON Schema cannot express (SPEC 5.6, 14.1, 17.1) are checked by the openavatar package's validate().

frontPoint.description: A front point [x, y]: where the line from (x, y, +infinity) toward -z first meets the solid (SPEC 4).

outline.description: A flat shape in the xy plane (SPEC 5.4).

driver.description: A standard animation driver id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

expressionId.description: A standard expression id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

motionId.description: A standard motion id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

propId.description: A standard prop id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

effectId.description: A standard effect id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

outfitId.description: A standard outfit id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.

materialRef.description: A material id from `materials`, or a material written in place.

face.description: Eyes, mouth, cheeks, brows and nose (SPEC 8).

attach.description: SPEC 9.1. At most one of position, at and direction.

propertyNames.description: A standard id id (vocabulary.json) or an x- vendor id.
